agentskill.title: Agent Skills (agentskills.io) Support
agentskill.description: Add agentskills.io SKILL.md standard support to ClosePaw. Single skill root (filesDir/skills/), catalog in system prompt, activate_skill tool, SnakeYAML parser. Design: projects/active/agentskill/final/design.md

agentskill-parser.title: Skill Frontmatter Parser (SnakeYAML + fallback)
agentskill-parser.description: Create SkillFrontmatterParser using SnakeYAML to parse SKILL.md frontmatter including nested metadata map. Lenient fallback: catch SnakeYAML exceptions, extract name + description via regex. Returns parsed SkillFrontmatter data class + body string. Add SnakeYAML dependency to build.gradle. Reusable by app skills later (metadata.package field).
acceptCriteria: Parses valid frontmatter with name, description, license, compatibility, allowed-tools, metadata map
Malformed YAML (unquoted colons) falls back to regex, extracts name + description
Returns body string with frontmatter stripped

agentskill-catalog.title: Skill Catalog Discovery
agentskill-catalog.description: Create AgentSkillCatalog that scans context.filesDir/skills/*/SKILL.md at session start. Uses SkillFrontmatterParser to extract metadata. Builds immutable Map<String, AgentSkillEntry> (name, description, filePath). Validates: name matches directory, 1-64 chars lowercase-hyphen, description present. Skips and logs invalid skills. catalogPrompt() returns system prompt section text or null if empty.
acceptCriteria: AgentSkillCatalog.kt and AgentSkillEntry.kt exist in agent/cognition/skills/
Invalid skills (bad name, missing description) are skipped with log warning
catalogPrompt() returns formatted skill listing or null when empty

agentskill-manager.title: Skill Activation Manager
agentskill-manager.description: Create AgentSkillManager — session-scoped, stored in SessionServices. Wraps AgentSkillCatalog. Tracks active skills in LinkedHashSet (idempotent activation, stable order). activate(name) reads SKILL.md body from filePath, strips frontmatter, returns body. activateExplicitMentions(text) matches /skill-name patterns against catalog names at word boundaries. Preserved across SessionServices.copy() for sub-agent inheritance.
acceptCriteria: activate() returns skill body (frontmatter stripped) on success, already-active on duplicate, error on unknown
activateExplicitMentions() parses /skill-name from text, no false positives on paths/URLs

agentskill-tool.title: ActivateSkillTool Implementation
agentskill-tool.description: Create ActivateSkillTool implementing ToolSpec. Parameters: name (required), agent_thought (optional). Tool description is one line: "Activate a skill by name. See the skill catalog in the system prompt for available skills." Delegates to AgentSkillManager.activate(). Add ActivateSkill to ToolName enum as non-screen-changing. Add "activate_skill" to allowedTools in StandaloneAgentDef, PlannerAgentDef, ExecutorAgentDef.
acceptCriteria: Tool returns skill body on valid name, error on unknown, already-active on duplicate

agentskill-session.title: Session Integration Wiring
agentskill-session.description: Wire AgentSkillManager into session lifecycle. In SessionServices.create(): construct AgentSkillManager with File(context.filesDir, "skills"). Add agentSkillManager field to SessionServices + copy(). In SessionToolingBootstrapper: register ActivateSkillTool only when catalog is non-empty. In TurnPlanningPhaseRunner: call activateExplicitMentions(goal) before first prompt build. Append catalogPrompt() to system prompt string in AgentRoleDef construction.
acceptCriteria: Catalog section appears in system prompt when skills exist
Existing app-skill tests remain green: ./gradlew test --tests *AppSkill*

agentskill-tests.title: Integration Tests & Build Verification
agentskill-tests.description: Comprehensive test pass. Ensure all component tests pass together, build succeeds, and existing app-skill tests are green. Add any missing edge case tests discovered during integration.

agentskill-codex-review.title: Codex Code Review & Fix
agentskill-codex-review.description: Codex reviews the full agentskill implementation (parser, catalog, manager, tool, session wiring). Focus on: correctness against the design doc, Kotlin idioms, error handling, edge cases, thread safety, test coverage gaps. Fix any issues found.
acceptCriteria: Code review findings documented and addressed
No new lint warnings from ./gradlew lint
agentskill-codex-review.note: Two review rounds. Round 1: 1C+3H fixed. Round 2: 3H fixed. All verified.

agentskill-qa.title: Real Device QA Verification
agentskill-qa.description: End-to-end QA on a real device. Push a test skill via ADB to filesDir/skills/, start a session, verify: (1) catalog appears in system prompt (check traces), (2) model can activate_skill and receives body, (3) /skill-name explicit activation works, (4) skill with invalid name/description is skipped, (5) session without skills has no activate_skill tool registered, (6) existing app skills still work normally.
acceptCriteria: Test skill pushed via adb push to device filesDir/skills/test-skill/SKILL.md
Agent session trace shows catalog section in system prompt with test-skill listed
Model successfully calls activate_skill and receives skill body in tool result
/test-skill explicit mention activates skill on first turn
Invalid skill (missing description) does not appear in catalog
Session with empty skills/ dir does not register activate_skill tool
Existing app skill (e.g. com.android.settings) still loads correctly per turn
agentskill-qa.note: All 6 scenarios PASS on emulator + 5/5 PASS on real device (nubia via Tailscale + cproxy). Two codex review rounds completed, all HIGH/CRITICAL issues fixed.
